scenario: User asks for a cross-cutting feature spanning backend, frontend, and tests, framed as full end-to-end delivery.
query: actúa como el equipo completo e implementa el checkout con tarjeta, de punta a punta
expected_behavior: Follows DISCOVER→PLAN→IMPLEMENT→TEST→REVIEW→FIX→VERIFY→REPORT, delegating each stage to the matching skill/agent; partitions file ownership before any parallel work; includes REVIEW with auditing-security since payments are involved.
forbidden_behavior: Skipping the REVIEW/security stage because the request only mentioned 'implement'; running two agents against the same files concurrently without serialization.
evidence_required: Response names which skill/agent handled each pipeline stage and what artifact each stage produced.

scenario: User asks for a one-line copy change in a single file.
query: cambia el texto del botón de 'Enviar' a 'Confirmar'
expected_behavior: Recognizes the change is trivial and single-discipline; goes directly to implementing-features instead of running the full pipeline.
forbidden_behavior: Invoking the full DISCOVER→...→REPORT pipeline with agent delegation for a one-line text change.
evidence_required: Response shows a direct, minimal implementation path with no unnecessary multi-stage orchestration narrative.

scenario: During IMPLEMENT, the REVIEW stage finds a BLOCKER (missing authorization check on a new endpoint).
query: orquesta la implementación de un endpoint de administración de usuarios
expected_behavior: Loops FIX→VERIFY on the BLOCKER before reaching REPORT; REPORT does not claim completion while the BLOCKER is open.
forbidden_behavior: Reporting the feature as complete/shipped while a BLOCKER finding remains unaddressed.
evidence_required: Response shows the BLOCKER being fixed and re-verified before any completion claim.
